metadata.description: Runs 582 bounded direct reads, four GitLab REST ETL streams, and 381 provider mutations through direct-write and approval-gated reverse-ETL commands; the groups deletion action also has one execution-bound, response-captured single-attempt warehouse-to-destination route.
metadata.name: gitlab

risk.approval: Every GitLab reverse-ETL action requires the standard plan, preview, explicit approval, and execute flow.
risk.read: external GitLab API read of projects, groups, users, and issues
risk.write: 381 source-bound GitLab mutations have one-request direct-write commands and approval-gated reverse-ETL commands; groups deletion additionally has a saved single-attempt destination route that never claims provider retry safety or read-back. The remaining provider mutations retain cited named-foundation outcomes.

access_token.description: GitLab personal access token or OAuth access token. Used only for Bearer auth; never logged.

base_url.description: GitLab API base URL override, e.g. https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4 for self-managed instances, or for tests/proxies.

mlflow_metric_key.description: Required MLflow metric_key query value for the source-bound metrics-history ETL stream.

mlflow_run_id.description: Required MLflow run_id query value for the source-bound metrics-history ETL stream.

mode.description: Runtime mode: live (default) or fixture for credential-free tests.

project_id.description: GitLab project ID or URL-encoded project path for the source-bound MLflow metrics-history ETL stream.

start_date.description: RFC3339 lower bound applied as each stream's matching since-filter (last_activity_after for projects, created_after for users, updated_after for issues; groups has no since-filter upstream).

error_map.hint: gitlab access_token is missing or invalid; re-run pm credentials add gitlab
gitlab token lacks access for this resource
gitlab rate limit exceeded; the connector will retry with backoff

operation.approval: none; read-only source-bound full-refresh ETL remains bounded and redacted
operation.summary: Gets metric history for a run
